title: Correct magnetic induction
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (1) must be 0.2 T.

title: Correct Ampere force
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (2) must be 0.2 N.

title: Apply Ampere's Law
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the formula F = BIL or its rearrangement to relate force, field, current, and length.

title: Correct unit usage
description: Important: All final answers must include the correct SI units (Tesla for B, Newton for F).

title: Clear problem setup
description: Optional: The response may show a clear substitution of the given values into the correct formula.

title: Incorrect formula application
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect formula (e.g., F = BIL sinθ with an incorrect angle).

title: Algebraic or arithmetic error
description: Pitfall: Penalize for mistakes in rearranging B = F/(IL) or calculating F = BIL with the new current.
